confidence_notes: Medium. Meal and coffee anchors rest on web-search summaries of aggregated price indexes for Marmaris (e.g., Numbeo, Citycost, combien-coute.net): inexpensive meal about US$7-10, mid-range dinner for two about US$37-43, cappuccino about US$3.5. Some pages were dated July 2026 and many were undated. Beer blends a July 2026 aggregator draft average (about US$3.2) with 2026 Marmaris venue price lists (Efes about 185-200 TRY per bottle). Cocktail (about 2.1x beer) and wine glass (about 1.4x beer) are weaker. No clean aggregate was found, so they use the local beer relationship, cross-checked against a 2026 nightlife guide (casual-venue cocktails about EUR 6-8, Bar Street higher) and conflicting 2026 lists (180 vs 300 TRY per glass of wine). Lira volatility and tourist-strip vs backstreet price gaps add uncertainty. Accommodation anchors are holistic July peak-season model estimates from general knowledge; no accommodation prices were searched or inspected.
comparable_city_reasoning: Marmaris-specific price-index data was used for food and drink. Accommodation is benchmarked holistically against Turkish Aegean/Mediterranean resort towns (cheaper than Bodrum, similar to Fethiye and Antalya) at July peak-season levels.
